sentence: The join of the four branches broke at SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.ZQ.OffZero.Time :18 in run 43818699881; main stands at 8fbab45d and no tag was cut; the four branches stand as they stood.

The coefficients of the Epstein zeta function of x^2 + xy + 6y^2, halved so that the coefficient at 1 is 1, are not multiplicative: the values at 2 and at 3 are 0 and the value at 6 is 2 (zq_coeff_not_multiplicative, SIDE-explicit-formula push-b757-coeff = 89eb71b6, run 43835333285, axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound). The hypothesis under which Mathlib proves an Euler product is one this series does not meet.

The coefficient at 48 of minus the logarithmic derivative of the Epstein zeta function of x^2 + xy + 6y^2 is -8 log 2 - 2 log 3, so these coefficients are not all nonnegative, where the von Mangoldt function is (cQ_not_nonneg and cQ_forty_eight, SIDE-explicit-formula push-b757-coeff = e52f9060, run 43839463729, axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound). The value is the coefficient law's at discriminant -23.

The units modulo 24 are compiled as isomorphic to the product of three groups of order two, by the three quadratic characters of conductors 3, 4 and 8 (units24_iso_signs, SIDE-dirichlet-mod-24 v0.2.0 = e5ebdd15, run 43836415096, axioms: propext); with it, ab = a + b + 1 for 2 <= a < b exactly at (2, 3).

For the Epstein zeta function of x^2 + xy + 6y^2 there is a test function in classK at which the arithmetic side of its explicit formula, pole term less prime-power side plus archimedean term, has negative real part (zq_arith_side_re_neg, SIDE-explicit-formula push-b757-coeff = 596d1c9e, run 43841545568, axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound); the direction that gives it holds for every configuration in the strip -1/2 < Re s < 3/2 with the count bound and a point off the line (wide_detector). The zero behind it at the control is the one located off the line near height 16.29.
